g_ir.name: local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm
g_ir.intuition: Keep the same local bipartite rank-window geometry and logistic rankgap mix weights, but replace the per-anchor budget with a per-instance top-k-by-weight cap after validity filtering; retain mirrored-pair dedup and per-instance weight normalization for stability.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    # Geometry: local bipartite rank-neighborhood pairing.
    gap_lo = int(hp.get("gap_lo", extra.get("gap_lo", 2)))
    gap_hi = int(hp.get("gap_hi", extra.get("gap_hi", 8)))

    # Constraint: filter near-ties by objective gap.
    min_gap = float(hp.get("min_gap", extra.get("min_gap", 0.01)))

    # Weighting: mix of objective-gap and rank-gap logistic weights.
    w_scale = float(hp.get("w_scale", extra.get("w_scale", 1.0)))
    rank_scale = float(hp.get("rank_scale", extra.get("rank_scale", 3.0)))
    mix = float(hp.get("mix", extra.get("mix", 0.65)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))

    # Cap: per-instance top-k strongest pairs (by weight) after validity filtering.
    k_instance = int(hp.get("k_instance", extra.get("k_instance", 256)))

    # Explicit constraint handling.
    per_instance_weight_norm = int(hp.get("per_instance_weight_norm", extra.get("per_instance_weight_norm", 1)))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if B == 0 or N <= 1:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm", "reason": "B==0_or_N<=1"})

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))

    # Rank order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Build rank-pair candidate mask in rank-position space.
    i = pos.view(N, 1)
    j = pos.view(1, N)
    rank_gap = (j - i)
    cross_part = ((i ^ j) & 1) == 1
    tri = j > i
    win_mask = tri & cross_part & (rank_gap >= gap_lo) & (rank_gap <= gap_hi)

    ij = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    if ij.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm", "reason": "no_candidates", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi})

    i_pos = ij[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    j_pos = ij[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)
    M = int(i_pos.numel())

    # Map rank positions -> sample indices per instance.
    w_all = order[:, i_pos]  # (B, M)
    l_all = order[:, j_pos]  # (B, M)

    w_obj = obj.gather(1, w_all)
    l_obj = obj.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (l_obj - w_obj)

    valid = (gap > (min_gap - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    rg = rank_gap[i_pos, j_pos].to(dtype=obj.dtype).view(1, M).expand(B, M)
    w_obj_part = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    w_rank_part = torch.sigmoid((rg - float(gap_lo)) / (rank_scale + eps))
    mix = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, mix)))
    wt_all = mix * w_obj_part + (1.0 - mix) * w_rank_part
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    # --- Per-instance top-k cap (vectorized; no Python loops over pairs) ---
    k_instance = int(max(0, k_instance))
    if k_instance == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm", "reason": "k_instance==0", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_instance": k_instance})

    neg_inf = torch.full((B, M), -1e9, device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid, wt_all, neg_inf)

    ord_m = score.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)
    rank_m = torch.empty_like(ord_m)
    rank_m.scatter_(1, ord_m, torch.arange(M, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(1, M).expand(B, M))

    keep_m = valid & (rank_m < min(k_instance, M))
    b_idx, p_idx = keep_m.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm", "reason": "cap_removed_all", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_instance": k_instance})

    winner_idx = w_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = l_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    weight = wt_all[b_idx, p_idx]

    # --- Explicit constraint operation: canonicalize + dedup mirrored/self pairs per instance ---
    a = torch.minimum(winner_idx, loser_idx)
    c = torch.maximum(winner_idx, loser_idx)
    keep = (a != c) & (weight > 0)
    if keep.any():
        b2 = b_idx[keep]
        w2i = winner_idx[keep]
        l2i = loser_idx[keep]
        wt2 = weight[keep]

        # Sort by (b, min(i,j), max(i,j)) so identical unordered pairs become adjacent.
        key2 = b2.to(dtype=torch.long) * (N * N + 1) + a[keep].to(dtype=torch.long) * (N + 1) + c[keep].to(dtype=torch.long)
        ord2 = key2.argsort()
        b2 = b2[ord2]
        w2i = w2i[ord2]
        l2i = l2i[ord2]
        wt2 = wt2[ord2]
        key2 = key2[ord2]

        first_mask = torch.ones((key2.numel(),), device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
        first_mask[1:] = key2[1:] != key2[:-1]
        b_idx = b2[first_mask]
        winner_idx = w2i[first_mask]
        loser_idx = l2i[first_mask]
        weight = wt2[first_mask]
    else:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm", "reason": "dedup_removed_all"})

    # --- Explicit constraint operation: per-instance weight normalization (stability) ---
    if per_instance_weight_norm != 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        denom = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)
        denom.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, weight)
        denom = torch.clamp(denom, eps, 1e12)
        weight = weight / denom.gather(0, b_idx)

    meta = {
        "builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_instance_topk_cap_dedupnorm",
        "gap_lo": int(gap_lo),
        "gap_hi": int(gap_hi),
        "min_gap": float(min_gap),
        "w_scale": float(w_scale),
        "rank_scale": float(rank_scale),
        "mix": float(mix),
        "w_clip": float(w_clip),
        "k_instance": int(k_instance),
        "per_instance_weight_norm": int(per_instance_weight_norm)
    }

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), winner_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), loser_idx.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=weight,
        meta=meta,
    )

g_ir.name: disagreement_triangle_quantilecap_v1
g_ir.intuition: Paradigm shift to disagreement-driven triangle pairing: focus on items whose objective rank and log-prob rank disagree, then compare each such item against both a better-ranked and a worse-ranked neighbor band to generate calibration-relevant, non-anchor, non-bipartite pairs.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache['objective']
    lp = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {})

    # Geometry: disagreement-driven triangle band around each selected center rank.
    # Select centers where objective-rank and log_prob-rank disagree; pair each center
    # to both better and worse neighbors within a rank band.
    band = int(hp.get('band', extra.get('band', 6)))
    center_q = float(hp.get('center_q', extra.get('center_q', 0.35)))

    # Constraints.
    min_gap = float(hp.get('min_gap', extra.get('min_gap', 0.01)))

    # Weighting: disagreement magnitude * softplus(objective gap) with clamping.
    dis_scale = float(hp.get('dis_scale', extra.get('dis_scale', 4.0)))
    gap_scale = float(hp.get('gap_scale', extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0)))
    w_max = float(hp.get('w_max', extra.get('w_max', 10.0)))

    # Cap: per-instance keep top-k center items by disagreement.
    max_centers = int(hp.get('max_centers', extra.get('max_centers', 32)))

    eps = float(hp.get('eps', extra.get('eps', 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if B == 0 or N <= 1 or lp is None:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={'builder': 'disagreement_triangle_quantilecap_v1', 'reason': 'B==0_or_N<=1_or_no_log_prob'})

    band = int(max(1, min(band, N - 1)))
    center_q = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, center_q)))

    # Objective order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order_obj = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    # Log-prob order: higher log_prob is better, so sort descending.
    order_lp = (-lp).argsort(dim=1)

    # Build rank positions for each item under each ordering.
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(1, N).expand(B, N)
    rank_obj = torch.empty((B, N), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    rank_obj.scatter_(1, order_obj, pos)
    rank_lp = torch.empty((B, N), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    rank_lp.scatter_(1, order_lp, pos)

    # Disagreement score per item (larger => more disagreement).
    dis = (rank_obj - rank_lp).abs().to(dtype=obj.dtype)

    # Choose centers: top-k by disagreement per instance, where k is quantile-based.
    kq = int(max(1, min(N, int(center_q * float(N)))))
    k_cent = int(max(1, min(max_centers, kq)))

    dis_top, center_pos = dis.topk(k=k_cent, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # center_pos are item indices

    # Build rank-space offsets for neighbor bands (better and worse than center in objective rank).
    offs = torch.arange(1, band + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)  # (band,)

    c_rank = rank_obj.gather(1, center_pos)  # (B, k_cent)

    r_better = (c_rank[:, :, None] - offs.view(1, 1, band)).clamp(0, N - 1)  # (B,k,band)
    r_worse = (c_rank[:, :, None] + offs.view(1, 1, band)).clamp(0, N - 1)   # (B,k,band)

    # Map neighbor ranks -> item indices via objective order.
    better_idx = order_obj.gather(1, r_better.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, k_cent, band)
    worse_idx = order_obj.gather(1, r_worse.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, k_cent, band)

    center_idx = center_pos[:, :, None].expand(B, k_cent, band)

    # Two directed pair sets:
    # 1) better beats center
    # 2) center beats worse
    w1 = better_idx
    l1 = center_idx
    w2 = center_idx
    l2 = worse_idx

    # Compute objective gaps and validity (avoid self and near-ties).
    ow1 = obj.gather(1, w1.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(w1)
    ol1 = obj.gather(1, l1.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(l1)
    gap1 = (ol1 - ow1)

    ow2 = obj.gather(1, w2.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(w2)
    ol2 = obj.gather(1, l2.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(l2)
    gap2 = (ol2 - ow2)

    v1 = (gap1 > (min_gap - eps)) & (w1 != l1)
    v2 = (gap2 > (min_gap - eps)) & (w2 != l2)

    # Weight: center disagreement * softplus(gap/gap_scale).
    dis_c = dis.gather(1, center_pos).clamp_min(0.0)  # (B,k)
    dis_w = (dis_c / (dis_scale + eps)).clamp(0.0, 1e6)
    dis_w = dis_w[:, :, None].expand(B, k_cent, band)

    wt1 = (dis_w * torch.nn.functional.softplus(gap1 / (gap_scale + eps))).clamp(0.0, w_max)
    wt2 = (dis_w * torch.nn.functional.softplus(gap2 / (gap_scale + eps))).clamp(0.0, w_max)

    # Flatten and select valid pairs.
    bgrid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, k_cent, band)

    b1, p1, q1 = v1.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    b2, p2, q2 = v2.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    if b1.numel() == 0 and b2.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={'builder': 'disagreement_triangle_quantilecap_v1', 'reason': 'all_filtered'})

    b_idx = torch.cat([bgrid[b1, p1, q1], bgrid[b2, p2, q2]], dim=0)
    winner_idx = torch.cat([w1[b1, p1, q1], w2[b2, p2, q2]], dim=0).to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = torch.cat([l1[b1, p1, q1], l2[b2, p2, q2]], dim=0).to(dtype=torch.long)
    weight = torch.cat([wt1[b1, p1, q1], wt2[b2, p2, q2]], dim=0)

    # Per-instance quantile-like cap on total pairs: keep top fraction by weight per instance.
    # Implemented as per-instance top-k with k derived from center_q and band.
    M_est = int(2 * k_cent * band)
    k_keep = int(max(1, min(M_est, int(center_q * float(M_est)))))

    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and k_keep > 0:
        # Sort by (b asc, weight desc) using a stable combined key.
        wbin = torch.clamp((weight * 4096.0).to(dtype=torch.long), 0, 2**30 - 1)
        bigw = 2**31 - 1
        key = b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long) * (bigw + 1) + (bigw - wbin)
        s = key.argsort()
        b_s = b_idx[s]
        w_s = winner_idx[s]
        l_s = loser_idx[s]
        wt_s = weight[s]

        is_new = torch.ones((b_s.numel(),), device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
        if b_s.numel() > 1:
            is_new[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
        gid = is_new.to(dtype=torch.long).cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        idx = torch.arange(b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        first = torch.full((int(gid.max().item()) + 1,), b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        first.scatter_reduce_(0, gid, idx, reduce='amin', include_self=True)
        pos_in = idx - first.gather(0, gid)
        keep = pos_in < min(k_keep, M_est)

        b_idx = b_s[keep]
        winner_idx = w_s[keep]
        loser_idx = l_s[keep]
        weight = wt_s[keep]

    weight = weight.clamp_min(0.0)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), winner_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), loser_idx.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'disagreement_triangle_quantilecap_v1',
            'band': int(band),
            'center_q': float(center_q),
            'max_centers': int(max_centers),
            'min_gap': float(min_gap),
            'dis_scale': float(dis_scale),
            'gap_scale': float(gap_scale),
            'w_max': float(w_max),
            'k_cent': int(k_cent),
            'k_keep': int(k_keep)
        }
    )

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"].detach()

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    alpha = float(hp.get("alpha", extra.get("alpha", 1.0)))
    beta = float(hp.get("beta", 0.10))

    tau_scale = float(hp.get("tau_scale", 0.50))
    tau_min = float(hp.get("tau_min", 0.25))
    temp_scale = float(hp.get("temp_scale", 1.0))

    mix = float(hp.get("mix", 0.15))
    cg_scale = float(hp.get("cg_scale", 1.0))

    clip = float(hp.get("clip", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-6))

    # Shift-invariant pairwise log-prob difference.
    d = lpw - lpl

    # Bounded, centered cost-gap modulation for temperature; keep tau positive via clamp.
    cg0 = cost_gap - cost_gap.mean()
    t = ops.tanh(cg0 / (temp_scale + eps))
    tau = ops.clamp(1.0 + tau_scale * t, tau_min, 1e6)

    base_margin = (alpha * d) / tau

    # Detached cost-informed target margin (bounded) mixed in for calibrated shaping.
    cg_target = -beta * ops.tanh(cost_gap / (cg_scale + eps))
    margin = (1.0 - mix) * base_margin + mix * cg_target

    # Smooth saturation to limit extreme margins without explicit clamp(-clip, clip).
    x = margin / (1.0 + ops.abs(margin) / (clip + eps))

    per_loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)

    wsum = ops.clamp(weight.sum(), eps, 1e12)
    return (per_loss * weight).sum() / wsum

A bounded tanh-based affine temperature uses centered detached cost_gap to modulate sharpness while preventing runaway scaling and keeping gradients driven by preference signal. A small convex mix with a bounded cost-informed target margin provides controllable shaping without backpropagating through costs. Weighted normalization by sum of weights keeps the scalar objective stable under varying batch weights.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # present for interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})
    k_hi = int(hp.get("k_hi", extra.get("k_hi", 3)))
    k_lo = int(hp.get("k_lo", extra.get("k_lo", 2)))
    min_gap = float(hp.get("min_gap", extra.get("min_gap", 0.0)))
    w_scale = float(hp.get("w_scale", extra.get("w_scale", 1.0)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    # Percentile-based per-instance cap: keep pairs whose weight is >= per-instance quantile.
    # q in [0,1]; q=0 keeps all, q=1 keeps only the max (if any).
    cap_quantile = float(hp.get("cap_quantile", extra.get("cap_quantile", 0.75)))
    cap_quantile = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, cap_quantile)))
    # Optional hard upper bound after quantile selection.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get("max_pairs_per_instance", extra.get("max_pairs_per_instance", 0)))

    B, K = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    k_hi_eff = int(min(max(k_hi, 0), max(K - 1, 0)))
    k_lo_eff = int(min(max(k_lo, 0), max(K - 1, 0)))

    best_val, best_idx = obj.min(dim=1)
    worst_val, worst_idx = obj.max(dim=1)

    if k_hi_eff > 0:
        hi_vals, hi_idx = obj.topk(k=k_hi_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        bA = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(B, 1).expand(B, k_hi_eff).reshape(-1)
        wA = best_idx.view(B, 1).expand(B, k_hi_eff).reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.long)
        lA = hi_idx.reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.long)
        gapA = (hi_vals - best_val.view(B, 1)).reshape(-1)
    else:
        bA = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        wA = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        lA = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        gapA = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)

    if k_lo_eff > 0:
        lo_vals, lo_idx = obj.topk(k=k_lo_eff, dim=1, largest=False, sorted=False)
        bB = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(B, 1).expand(B, k_lo_eff).reshape(-1)
        wB = lo_idx.reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.long)
        lB = worst_idx.view(B, 1).expand(B, k_lo_eff).reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.long)
        gapB = (worst_val.view(B, 1) - lo_vals).reshape(-1)
    else:
        bB = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        wB = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        lB = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        gapB = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)

    b_idx = torch.cat([bA, bB], dim=0)
    w_idx = torch.cat([wA, wB], dim=0)
    l_idx = torch.cat([lA, lB], dim=0)
    gap = torch.cat([gapA, gapB], dim=0)

    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and (min_gap > 0.0):
        mask = gap >= (min_gap - eps)
        b_idx = b_idx[mask]
        w_idx = w_idx[mask]
        l_idx = l_idx[mask]
        gap = gap[mask]

    weight = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    weight = torch.clamp(weight, 0.0, w_clip)

    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        self_mask = w_idx != l_idx
        b_idx = b_idx[self_mask]
        w_idx = w_idx[self_mask]
        l_idx = l_idx[self_mask]
        weight = weight[self_mask]

    # Deduplicate (b,w,l) keeping max weight.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        key = (b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long) * (K * K) + w_idx.to(dtype=torch.long) * K + l_idx.to(dtype=torch.long))
        uniq_w = torch.full((B * K * K,), -1.0, device=device, dtype=weight.dtype)
        uniq_w.scatter_reduce_(0, key, weight, reduce="amax", include_self=True)
        kept = uniq_w > 0
        kept_keys = kept.nonzero(as_tuple=False).reshape(-1)
        if kept_keys.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = (kept_keys // (K * K)).to(dtype=torch.long)
            rem = kept_keys - b_idx * (K * K)
            w_idx = (rem // K).to(dtype=torch.long)
            l_idx = (rem - w_idx * K).to(dtype=torch.long)
            weight = uniq_w[kept_keys]
        else:
            b_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            w_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            l_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            weight = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)

    # Percentile cap per instance (vectorized): keep pairs with weight >= per-instance threshold.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and cap_quantile > 0.0:
        ones = torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long)
        counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        counts.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, ones)
        maxC = int(counts.max().item())
        if maxC > 0:
            offsets = torch.zeros((B + 1,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            offsets[1:] = counts.cumsum(0)
            pos_in_b = torch.arange(b_idx.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long) - offsets[b_idx]

            w_table = torch.full((B, maxC), -1e9, device=device, dtype=weight.dtype)
            w_table[b_idx, pos_in_b] = weight

            w_sorted, _ = w_table.sort(dim=1, descending=False)

            # index for quantile threshold within each row's valid count.
            # Use ceil(q*(n-1)) to be conservative when q is high.
            n = counts.clamp_min(1)
            qpos = (cap_quantile * (n.to(dtype=torch.float32) - 1.0)).ceil().to(dtype=torch.long)
            qpos = qpos.clamp(0, maxC - 1)
            thresh = w_sorted.gather(1, qpos.view(B, 1)).reshape(-1)

            keep = weight >= (thresh[b_idx] - eps)
            b_idx = b_idx[keep]
            w_idx = w_idx[keep]
            l_idx = l_idx[keep]
            weight = weight[keep]

    # Optional hard upper bound after percentile cap (still vectorized top-k by weight).
    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        cap = int(max(0, max_pairs_per_instance))
        if cap == 0:
            b_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            w_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            l_idx = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            weight = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)
        else:
            ones = torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long)
            counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            counts.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, ones)
            maxC = int(counts.max().item())
            if maxC > cap:
                offsets = torch.zeros((B + 1,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                offsets[1:] = counts.cumsum(0)
                pos_in_b = torch.arange(b_idx.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long) - offsets[b_idx]

                idx_table = torch.full((B, maxC), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                w_table = torch.full((B, maxC), -1e9, device=device, dtype=weight.dtype)
                idx_table[b_idx, pos_in_b] = torch.arange(b_idx.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                w_table[b_idx, pos_in_b] = weight

                k_sel = int(min(cap, maxC))
                _, sel_pos = w_table.topk(k=k_sel, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
                sel_flat = idx_table.gather(1, sel_pos).reshape(-1)
                sel_flat = sel_flat[sel_flat >= 0]

                b_idx = b_idx[sel_flat]
                w_idx = w_idx[sel_flat]
                l_idx = l_idx[sel_flat]
                weight = weight[sel_flat]

    meta = {
        "k_hi": int(k_hi_eff),
        "k_lo": int(k_lo_eff),
        "min_gap": float(min_gap),
        "weight_scale": float(w_scale),
        "weight_clip": float(w_clip),
        "cap_quantile": float(cap_quantile),
        "max_pairs_per_instance": int(max_pairs_per_instance),
    }

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), w_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), l_idx.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=weight,
        meta=meta,
    )

g_ir.intuition: Keep the same local bipartite rank-window geometry and logistic rankgap mix weights, but add an explicit per-instance constraint pass that clamps extreme weights and applies a top-k-by-weight cap over unique pairs (after tie-zone filtering) to stabilize batch composition without changing pairwise PrefBatch semantics.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    # Geometry: local bipartite rank-neighborhood pairing.
    gap_lo = int(hp.get("gap_lo", extra.get("gap_lo", 2)))
    gap_hi = int(hp.get("gap_hi", extra.get("gap_hi", 8)))

    # Constraint: filter near-ties by objective gap.
    min_gap = float(hp.get("min_gap", extra.get("min_gap", 0.01)))

    # Weighting: mix of objective-gap and rank-gap logistic weights.
    w_scale = float(hp.get("w_scale", extra.get("w_scale", 1.0)))
    rank_scale = float(hp.get("rank_scale", extra.get("rank_scale", 3.0)))
    mix = float(hp.get("mix", extra.get("mix", 0.65)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))

    # Cap: per-instance max unique pairs kept (top-k by weight).
    k_pairs = int(hp.get("k_pairs", extra.get("k_pairs", 256)))

    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if B == 0 or N <= 1:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_anchorcap_tiezone_topkpair", "reason": "B==0_or_N<=1"})

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))

    # Rank order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Candidate rank-pairs in a bipartite (even/odd) window.
    i = pos.view(N, 1)
    j = pos.view(1, N)
    rank_gap = (j - i)
    cross_part = ((i ^ j) & 1) == 1
    tri = j > i
    win_mask = tri & cross_part & (rank_gap >= gap_lo) & (rank_gap <= gap_hi)

    ij = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    if ij.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v3_anchorcap_tiezone_topkpair", "reason": "no_candidates", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi})

    i_pos = ij[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    j_pos = ij[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)
    M = int(i_pos.numel())

    w_all = order[:, i_pos]  # (B, M)
    l_all = order[:, j_pos]  # (B, M)

    w_obj = obj.gather(1, w_all)
    l_obj = obj.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (l_obj - w_obj)

    # Explicit constraint op: tie-zone filtering by objective gap.
    valid = (gap > (min_gap - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    rg = rank_gap[i_pos, j_pos].to(dtype=obj.dtype).view(1, M).expand(B, M)
    w_obj_part = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    w_rank_part = torch.sigmoid((rg - float(gap_lo)) / (rank_scale + eps))
    mix = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, mix)))
    wt_all = mix * w_obj_part + (1.0 - mix) * w_rank_part

    # Explicit constraint op: clamp extreme weights.
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    # Flatten valid pairs for selection.

    beta = float(hp.get("beta", 0.10))

    tau_scale = float(hp.get("tau_scale", 0.50))
    tau_min = float(hp.get("tau_min", 0.25))
    temp_scale = float(hp.get("temp_scale", 1.0))

    mix = float(hp.get("mix", 0.15))
    cg_scale = float(hp.get("cg_scale", 1.0))

    clip = float(hp.get("clip", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-6))

    d = lpw - lpl

    # Bounded, centered cost-gap modulation for temperature; keep tau positive via clamp.
    cg0 = cost_gap - cost_gap.mean()
    t = ops.tanh(cg0 / (temp_scale + eps))
    tau = ops.clamp(1.0 + tau_scale * t, tau_min, 1e6)

    B, N = objective.shape

    # Pairwise objective gaps: positive means i is better than j.
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    mask = gap > gap_thr

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Optional per-instance cap by strongest gaps.
    if max_pairs_per_instance > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        scores_all = gap[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]

        # Count pairs per instance.
        ones = scores_all.new_ones((b_idx.numel(),), dtype=objective.dtype)
        counts = objective.new_zeros((B,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, b_idx, ones)

        # Assign within-instance rank via stable sort on (b, -score).

        key = (b_idx.to(dtype=neg_scores.dtype) * (neg_scores.abs().max() + 1.0)) + neg_scores

        b_s = b_idx[order]
        w_s = winner_idx[order]
        l_s = loser_idx[order]
        s_s = scores_all[order]

        # Within each instance, compute 0..count-1 positions.

        total = b_s.numel()
        ar = torch.arange(total, device=objective.device)
        first = objective.new_full((B,), total, dtype=torch.long)
        first = first.scatter_reduce(0, b_s, ar, reduce='amin', include_self=True)
        pos = ar - first[b_s]

        keep = pos < max_pairs_per_instance
        b_idx = b_s[keep]
        winner_idx = w_s[keep]
        loser_idx = l_s[keep]

    # Global cap by strongest gaps.
    if max_pairs > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:

            b_idx = b_idx[topk_pos]
            winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_pos]
            loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_pos]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'gap_capped_pairs_dualcap', 'gap_threshold': gap_thr, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance})

g_ir.intuition: Anchor-vs-rank-band: compare a few extreme anchors (best and worst) against a narrow rank neighborhood to create hard, informative pairs; weight pairs by a smooth confidence from objective and policy disagreement.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {})
    band = int(hp.get('band', extra.get('band', 2)))
    top_anchors = int(hp.get('top_anchors', extra.get('top_anchors', 2)))
    bottom_anchors = int(hp.get('bottom_anchors', extra.get('bottom_anchors', 1)))
    max_pairs = int(hp.get('max_pairs', extra.get('max_pairs', 0)))

    # We assume lower objective is better.
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Rank candidates per instance.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # (B,K) best..worst
    inv_rank = order.argsort(dim=1)  # (B,K) rank position for each original index

    # Anchor sets (best few and worst few), in original index space.
    a_top = order[:, :max(1, top_anchors)]
    a_bot = order[:, K - max(1, bottom_anchors):]
    anchors = torch.cat([a_top, a_bot], dim=1)  # (B,A)
    A = anchors.shape[1]

    # Candidate pairs: each anchor vs a local rank band around it (excluding itself).
    delta = torch.arange(-band, band + 1, device=device)
    ar = inv_rank.gather(1, anchors)  # (B,A)
    nbr_r = (ar[:, :, None] + delta[None, None, :]).clamp(0, K - 1)  # (B,A,2b+1)
    nbr = order.gather(1, nbr_r.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, A, -1)  # (B,A,2b+1) orig idx

    # Exclude self-neighbor positions.
    valid = nbr != anchors[:, :, None]

    # Winner/loser determined by objective.
    obj_a = objective.gather(1, anchors)[:, :, None]  # (B,A,1)
    obj_n = objective.gather(1, nbr.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, A, -1)  # (B,A,2b+1)
    w_is_a = obj_a < obj_n
    w_idx = torch.where(w_is_a, anchors[:, :, None], nbr)
    l_idx = torch.where(w_is_a, nbr, anchors[:, :, None])

    # Apply valid mask and flatten.
    mask = valid
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None, None].expand_as(w_idx)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Map indices from (B,A,N) into flattened tensors via advanced indexing.
    w_flat = w_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    l_flat = l_idx[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    b_flat = b_grid[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]

    # Pair weights: objective gap confidence * policy disagreement.
    ogap = (objective[b_flat, l_flat] - objective[b_flat, w_flat]).clamp(0.0, 1e12)
    # Disagreement uses |log_prob_w - log_prob_l|; supports log_prob shaped (B,K) or (B,K,1).
    lp = log_prob
    if lp.dim() == 3 and lp.size(-1) == 1:
        lp = lp.squeeze(-1)
    dlp = (lp[b_flat, w_flat] - lp[b_flat, l_flat]).abs()

    gap_scale = float(hp.get('gap_scale', extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0)))
    dis_scale = float(hp.get('dis_scale', extra.get('dis_scale', 1.0)))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', extra.get('eps', 1e-6)))

    # Smooth confidence in [0, +inf) without hard thresholds.
    w_gap = torch.nn.functional.softplus(ogap / (gap_scale + eps))
    w_dis = torch.sigmoid(dlp / (dis_scale + eps))
    weight = (w_gap * w_dis).clamp(0.0, 1e6)

    # Optional global cap: keep highest-weight pairs.
    if max_pairs and b_flat.numel() > max_pairs:
        keep = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_flat = b_flat[keep]
        w_flat = w_flat[keep]
        l_flat = l_flat[keep]
        weight = weight[keep]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_flat, w_flat, l_flat), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'anchor_rankband_confidence', 'band': band, 'top_anchors': top_anchors, 'bottom_anchors': bottom_anchors, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw", "reason": "B==0_or_N<=1"})

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))

    # Rank order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Candidate rank-pairs in a bipartite (even/odd) window.
    i = pos.view(N, 1)
    j = pos.view(1, N)
    rank_gap = (j - i)
    cross_part = ((i ^ j) & 1) == 1
    tri = j > i
    win_mask = tri & cross_part & (rank_gap >= gap_lo) & (rank_gap <= gap_hi)

    ij = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    if ij.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw", "reason": "no_candidates", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi})

    i_pos = ij[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    j_pos = ij[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)
    M = int(i_pos.numel())

    w_all = order[:, i_pos]  # (B, M)
    l_all = order[:, j_pos]  # (B, M)

    w_obj = obj.gather(1, w_all)
    l_obj = obj.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (l_obj - w_obj)

    # Explicit constraint op: tie-zone filtering by objective gap.
    valid = (gap > (min_gap - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    rg = rank_gap[i_pos, j_pos].to(dtype=obj.dtype).view(1, M).expand(B, M)
    w_obj_part = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    w_rank_part = torch.sigmoid((rg - float(gap_lo)) / (rank_scale + eps))
    mix = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, mix)))
    wt_all = mix * w_obj_part + (1.0 - mix) * w_rank_part

    # Explicit constraint op: clamp extreme weights.
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    keep0 = valid & (wt_all > 0)
    b_idx, p_idx = keep0.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw", "reason": "all_filtered", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "min_gap": float(min_gap)})

    winner_idx = w_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = l_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    weight = wt_all[b_idx, p_idx]

    # Canonicalize unordered identity for dedup key (keeps original winner/loser orientation).
    a = torch.minimum(winner_idx, loser_idx)
    c = torch.maximum(winner_idx, loser_idx)

    # Sort by (b, a, c, -weight) so the strongest duplicate is first.
    wbin = torch.clamp((weight * 4096.0).to(dtype=torch.long), 0, 2**30 - 1)
    big_ac = N + 1
    big_w = 2**31 - 1
    key = b_idx * (big_ac * big_ac) * (big_w + 1) + a * big_ac * (big_w + 1) + c * (big_w + 1) + (big_w - wbin)
    ord1 = key.argsort()

    b1 = b_idx[ord1]
    w1 = winner_idx[ord1]
    l1 = loser_idx[ord1]
    wt1 = weight[ord1]
    a1 = a[ord1]
    c1 = c[ord1]

    # Explicit constraint op: dedup within instance by unordered pair identity.
    key_ac = b1 * (big_ac * big_ac) + a1 * big_ac + c1
    first = torch.ones((key_ac.numel(),), device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
    first[1:] = key_ac[1:] != key_ac[:-1]

    b2 = b1[first]
    w2 = w1[first]
    l2 = l1[first]
    wt2 = wt1[first]

    # Explicit constraint op: per-instance top-k unique pairs by weight.
    k_pairs = int(max(0, k_pairs))
    if k_pairs == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw", "reason": "k_pairs==0"})

    wbin2 = torch.clamp((wt2 * 4096.0).to(dtype=torch.long), 0, 2**30 - 1)
    key2 = b2 * (big_w + 1) + (big_w - wbin2)
    ord2 = key2.argsort()

    b3 = b2[ord2]
    w3 = w2[ord2]
    l3 = l2[ord2]
    wt3 = wt2[ord2]

    is_new = torch.ones((b3.numel(),), device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
    is_new[1:] = b3[1:] != b3[:-1]
    start = is_new.to(dtype=torch.long).cumsum(dim=0) - 1
    idx = torch.arange(b3.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)

    num_groups = int(start.max().item()) + 1 if b3.numel() > 0 else 0
    first_pos = torch.full((num_groups,), b3.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    if num_groups > 0:
        first_pos.scatter_reduce_(0, start, idx, reduce="amin", include_self=True)
        within = idx - first_pos.gather(0, start)
        keepk = within < k_pairs
        b_idx = b3[keepk]
        winner_idx = w3[keepk]
        loser_idx = l3[keepk]
        weight = wt3[keepk]
    else:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw", "reason": "no_pairs_after_topk"})

    # Explicit constraint op: per-instance weight normalization (keeps nonneg, preserves pairwise semantics).
    norm_target = float(max(0.0, norm_target))
    if norm_target > 0.0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        per_sum = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)
        per_sum.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, weight)
        denom = per_sum.gather(0, b_idx)
        scale = norm_target / torch.clamp(denom, eps, 1e12)
        weight = weight * scale
        weight = torch.clamp(weight, 0.0, w_clip)

    meta = {
        "builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v4_anchorcap_tiezone_topk_normw",
        "gap_lo": int(gap_lo),
        "gap_hi": int(gap_hi),
        "min_gap": float(min_gap),
        "w_scale": float(w_scale),
        "rank_scale": float(rank_scale),
        "mix": float(mix),
        "w_clip": float(w_clip),
        "k_pairs": int(k_pairs),
        "norm_target": float(norm_target)
    }

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), winner_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), loser_idx.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=weight,
        meta=meta,
    )

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"].detach()

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    alpha = float(hp.get("alpha", extra.get("alpha", 1.0)))
    beta = float(hp.get("beta", 0.10))

    tau_scale = float(hp.get("tau_scale", 0.50))
    tau_min = float(hp.get("tau_min", 0.25))
    temp_scale = float(hp.get("temp_scale", 1.0))

    mix = float(hp.get("mix", 0.15))
    cg_scale = float(hp.get("cg_scale", 1.0))

    clip = float(hp.get("clip", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-6))

    # Shift-invariant pairwise log-prob difference.
    d = lpw - lpl

    # Bounded, centered cost-gap modulation for temperature; keep tau positive via clamp.
    cg0 = cost_gap - cost_gap.mean()
    t = ops.tanh(cg0 / (temp_scale + eps))
    tau = ops.clamp(1.0 + tau_scale * t, tau_min, 1e6)

    base_margin = (alpha * d) / tau

    # Detached cost-informed target margin (bounded) mixed in for calibrated shaping.
    cg_target = -beta * ops.tanh(cost_gap / (cg_scale + eps))
    margin = (1.0 - mix) * base_margin + mix * cg_target

    # Smooth saturation to limit extreme margins without explicit clamp(-clip, clip).
    x = margin / (1.0 + ops.abs(margin) / (clip + eps))

    per_loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)

    wsum = ops.clamp(weight.sum(), eps, 1e12)
    return (per_loss * weight).sum() / wsum
f_ir.theoretical_basis: Pairwise Bradley-Terry style logistic loss on the log-probability difference. A bounded tanh-based affine temperature uses centered detached cost_gap to modulate sharpness while preventing runaway scaling and keeping gradients driven by preference signal. A small convex mix with a bounded cost-informed target margin provides controllable shaping without backpropagating through costs. Weighted normalization by sum of weights keeps the scalar objective stable under varying batch weights.

g_ir.intuition: Keep the same local bipartite rank-gap window geometry and logistic mixed weighting, but replace the per-instance percentile cap with a per-anchor (winner) budget so each candidate contributes a bounded number of comparisons, improving coverage and reducing dominance by a few high-weight winners.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    # Geometry: local bipartite rank-neighborhood pairing.
    gap_lo = int(hp.get("gap_lo", extra.get("gap_lo", 2)))
    gap_hi = int(hp.get("gap_hi", extra.get("gap_hi", 8)))

    # Constraint: filter near-ties by objective gap.
    min_gap = float(hp.get("min_gap", extra.get("min_gap", 0.01)))

    # Weighting: mix of objective-gap and rank-gap logistic weights.
    w_scale = float(hp.get("w_scale", extra.get("w_scale", 1.0)))
    rank_scale = float(hp.get("rank_scale", extra.get("rank_scale", 3.0)))
    mix = float(hp.get("mix", extra.get("mix", 0.65)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))

    # Cap: per-anchor (winner) budget: keep up to k_per_winner strongest comparisons per winner.
    k_per_winner = int(hp.get("k_per_winner", extra.get("k_per_winner", 2)))

    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if B == 0 or N <= 1:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode="pairwise",
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype),
            meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget", "reason": "B==0_or_N<=1"},
        )

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))
    k_per_winner = int(max(0, k_per_winner))

    if k_per_winner == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode="pairwise",
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype),
            meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget", "reason": "k_per_winner==0"},
        )

    # Rank order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Candidate rank-position pairs: i<j, cross-partition, within [gap_lo, gap_hi].
    i = pos.view(N, 1)
    j = pos.view(1, N)
    rank_gap = (j - i)
    cross_part = ((i ^ j) & 1) == 1
    tri = j > i
    win_mask = tri & cross_part & (rank_gap >= gap_lo) & (rank_gap <= gap_hi)

    ij = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    if ij.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode="pairwise",
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype),
            meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "reason": "no_pairs"},
        )

    i_pos = ij[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    j_pos = ij[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)
    M = int(i_pos.numel())

    # Map rank positions -> sample indices per instance.
    w_all = order[:, i_pos]  # (B, M)
    l_all = order[:, j_pos]  # (B, M)

    w_obj = obj.gather(1, w_all)
    l_obj = obj.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (l_obj - w_obj)

    valid = (gap > (min_gap - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    rg = rank_gap[i_pos, j_pos].to(dtype=obj.dtype).view(1, M).expand(B, M)
    w_obj_part = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    w_rank_part = torch.sigmoid((rg - float(gap_lo)) / (rank_scale + eps))
    mix = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, mix)))
    wt_all = mix * w_obj_part + (1.0 - mix) * w_rank_part
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    # ---- Per-anchor (winner) top-k budget cap ----
    # For each batch b and winner index w in [0,N), keep up to k_per_winner candidate pairs
    # with the largest weight among those where w_all == w.
    masked = torch.where(valid, wt_all, wt_all.new_full((B, M), -1e9))

    # Build a per-pair key of (b, w_all) to compute the k-th largest threshold.
    # key in [0, B*N)
    key = (torch.arange(B, device=device).view(B, 1) * N + w_all).to(dtype=torch.long)

    # Sort pairs by descending weight; keep stable-ish by key.
    # We avoid Python loops; operate on flattened vectors.
    masked_f = masked.reshape(-1)
    key_f = key.reshape(-1)
    widx_f = w_all.reshape(-1)
    lidx_f = l_all.reshape(-1)
    b_f = torch.arange(B, device=device).view(B, 1).expand(B, M).reshape(-1)

    # Only consider pairs that are valid (masked > -1e8).
    ok = masked_f > (-1e8)
    if ok.sum() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode="pairwise",
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype),
            meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_per_winner": k_per_winner, "reason": "no_valid"},
        )

    masked_f = masked_f[ok]
    key_f = key_f[ok]
    widx_f = widx_f[ok]
    lidx_f = lidx_f[ok]
    b_f = b_f[ok]

    # Sort by key then by descending weight within each key.
    # Two-stage sort: sort by (-weight) primary, then key to group; then stable group by key.
    # Use composite score: key as major, weight as minor by sorting on (key, -weight).
    # Achieve via lexicographic-ish by sorting on (key * big + rank), but big must dominate.
    # Instead: sort by key first, then within-group topk via scatter-reduced thresholds.

    # Compute per-(b,w) threshold as the k-th largest weight using topk on dense (B*N, M) is too big.
    # Use scatter_reduce to compute max iteratively is not possible without loops; instead compute
    # an approximate threshold via taking topk globally per key with a second pass using topk on buckets.
    # Practical vectorized alternative: select all pairs, take topk across M per row after grouping winners.

    # Build dense (B, N, M) mask is too large; instead do a global topk over pairs per batch-winner by
    # using a two-pass method:
    # 1) For each key, compute max weight.
    # 2) Subtract and repeat is not allowed; so we compute threshold by keeping pairs whose weight is within
    #    the top-k according to rank among same key using counting of greater weights.

    # Compute rank-within-key: rank = number of pairs with strictly greater weight for the same key.
    # Use scatter_reduce to get, for each pair, the maximum weight for that key; then estimate rank by
    # comparing to per-key top-k candidates via iterative refinement is not possible.

    # Final practical cap: keep pairs whose weight is within (max - delta) where delta chosen so that
    # expected count ~ k_per_winner, and additionally hard-limit total pairs by global topk.
    # This stays vectorized and enforces per-anchor tendency.

    # Per-key max weight
    KN = B * N
    per_key_max = masked_f.new_full((KN,), -1e9)
    per_key_max = per_key_max.scatter_reduce(0, key_f, masked_f, reduce="amax", include_self=True)
    max_w = per_key_max[key_f]

    # Keep near-max pairs per key; delta derived from sigmoid scale so it's roughly top-k-ish.
    delta = float(hp.get("near_max_delta", extra.get("near_max_delta", 0.25)))
    delta = float(max(0.0, delta))
    keep1 = masked_f >= (max_w - delta)

    b1 = b_f[keep1]
    w1 = widx_f[keep1]
    l1 = lidx_f[keep1]
    wt1 = masked_f[keep1]

    if wt1.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode="pairwise",
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype),
            meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_per_winner": k_per_winner, "reason": "near_max_empty"},
        )

    # Hard per-key cap via global topk on an upper bound of pairs.
    # Budget = B * N * k_per_winner
    budget = int(min(int(extra.get("pairing_budget", hp.get("pairing_budget", B * N * k_per_winner))), int(B * N * k_per_winner)))
    budget = int(max(1, budget))

    if wt1.numel() > budget:
        _, sel = wt1.topk(k=budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b1 = b1[sel]
        w1 = w1[sel]
        l1 = l1[sel]
        wt1 = wt1[sel]

    meta = {
        "builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite_v2_anchor_budget",
        "gap_lo": int(gap_lo),
        "gap_hi": int(gap_hi),
        "min_gap": float(min_gap),
        "w_scale": float(w_scale),
        "rank_scale": float(rank_scale),
        "mix": float(mix),
        "w_clip": float(w_clip),
        "k_per_winner": int(k_per_winner),
        "near_max_delta": float(delta),
        "budget": int(budget),
        "candidates_M": int(M)
    }

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b1.to(dtype=torch.long), w1.to(dtype=torch.long), l1.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=wt1,
        meta=meta,
    )

g_ir.name: hybrid_extreme_anchorband_normcap_v1
g_ir.intuition: Mix two high-signal sparse geometries: (1) extreme-vs-topk pairs to anchor clear wins/losses and (2) a small anchor-vs-midrank band to add informative non-trivial comparisons; then apply tie-zone (absolute+relative) gap filtering, optional per-instance top-k capping by weight, and per-instance weight normalization so no instance dominates.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache['objective']
    _lp = feature_cache['log_prob']  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {})

    # Extremes geometry.
    k_hi = int(hp.get('k_hi', extra.get('k_hi', 3)))
    k_lo = int(hp.get('k_lo', extra.get('k_lo', 2)))

    # Anchor-band geometry.
    a_top = int(hp.get('a_top', extra.get('a_top', 1)))
    a_bot = int(hp.get('a_bot', extra.get('a_bot', 1)))
    band_lo = float(hp.get('band_lo', extra.get('band_lo', 0.25)))
    band_hi = float(hp.get('band_hi', extra.get('band_hi', 0.75)))

    # Tie-zone thresholds.
    min_gap = float(hp.get('min_gap', extra.get('min_gap', 0.0)))
    rel_gap = float(hp.get('rel_gap', extra.get('rel_gap', 0.0)))

    # Weighting (gap -> (0, w_clip]).
    w_scale = float(hp.get('w_scale', extra.get('w_scale', 1.0)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', extra.get('w_clip', 5.0)))

    # Constraints.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 192)))
    per_instance_weight_norm = int(hp.get('per_instance_weight_norm', extra.get('per_instance_weight_norm', 1)))

    eps = float(hp.get('eps', extra.get('eps', 1e-6)))

    B, K = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    # Effective ks.
    k_hi_eff = int(min(max(k_hi, 0), max(K - 1, 0)))
    k_lo_eff = int(min(max(k_lo, 0), max(K - 1, 0)))

    best_val, best_idx = obj.min(dim=1)
    worst_val, worst_idx = obj.max(dim=1)

    # --- Build candidate pairs in dense tables (B, Pmax) then mask/filter vectorized. ---

    # Extremes A: best vs top-k worst.
    if k_hi_eff > 0:
        hi_vals, hi_idx = obj.topk(k=k_hi_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        wA = best_idx.view(B, 1).expand(B, k_hi_eff)
        lA = hi_idx
        gapA = hi_vals - best_val.view(B, 1)
        baseA = best_val.view(B, 1).expand(B, k_hi_eff)
    else:
        wA = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        lA = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        gapA = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))
        baseA = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))

    # Extremes B: top-k best vs worst.
    if k_lo_eff > 0:
        lo_vals, lo_idx = obj.topk(k=k_lo_eff, dim=1, largest=False, sorted=False)
        wB = lo_idx
        lB = worst_idx.view(B, 1).expand(B, k_lo_eff)
        gapB = worst_val.view(B, 1) - lo_vals
        baseB = lo_vals
    else:
        wB = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        lB = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        gapB = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))
        baseB = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))

    # Anchor-band: anchors vs mid-rank band.
    a_top = int(max(0, min(a_top, K)))
    a_bot = int(max(0, min(a_bot, K)))
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)  # ascending; lower objective is better

    top_idx = order[:, :a_top]
    bot_idx = order[:, (K - a_bot):] if a_bot > 0 else order[:, :0]

    lo_pos = int(max(0, min(K, int((K - 1) * band_lo))))
    hi_pos = int(max(0, min(K - 1, int((K - 1) * band_hi))))
    if hi_pos < lo_pos:
        lo_pos, hi_pos = hi_pos, lo_pos

    pos = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    band_pos = pos[(pos >= lo_pos) & (pos <= hi_pos)]
    band_idx = order[:, band_pos]

    # top anchors (winners) vs band (losers)
    if top_idx.numel() > 0 and band_idx.numel() > 0:
        wC = top_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, top_idx.shape[1], band_idx.shape[1])
        lC = band_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, top_idx.shape[1], band_idx.shape[1])
        owC = obj.gather(1, wC.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(wC)
        olC = obj.gather(1, lC.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(lC)
        gapC = (olC - owC).reshape(B, -1)
        baseC = owC.reshape(B, -1)
        wC = wC.reshape(B, -1)
        lC = lC.reshape(B, -1)
    else:
        wC = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        lC = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        gapC = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))
        baseC = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))

    # band (winners) vs bottom anchors (losers)
    if bot_idx.numel() > 0 and band_idx.numel() > 0:
        wD = band_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, band_idx.shape[1], bot_idx.shape[1])
        lD = bot_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, band_idx.shape[1], bot_idx.shape[1])
        owD = obj.gather(1, wD.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(wD)
        olD = obj.gather(1, lD.reshape(B, -1)).reshape_as(lD)
        gapD = (olD - owD).reshape(B, -1)
        baseD = owD.reshape(B, -1)
        wD = wD.reshape(B, -1)
        lD = lD.reshape(B, -1)
    else:
        wD = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        lD = obj.new_zeros((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        gapD = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))
        baseD = obj.new_zeros((B, 0))

    w_all = torch.cat([wA, wB, wC, wD], dim=1)
    l_all = torch.cat([lA, lB, lC, lD], dim=1)
    gap_all = torch.cat([gapA, gapB, gapC, gapD], dim=1)
    base_all = torch.cat([baseA, baseB, baseC, baseD], dim=1)

    if w_all.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={'builder': 'hybrid_extreme_anchorband_normcap_v1'})

    # Tie-zone / validity mask (gap must be positive; apply abs+rel threshold; remove self-pairs).
    thr_rel = float(rel_gap) * (torch.abs(base_all) + eps)
    thr_abs = torch.full_like(gap_all, float(min_gap))
    thr = torch.maximum(thr_abs, thr_rel)
    m = (gap_all >= (thr - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    # Weights from gap (non-negative, bounded).
    wt_all = torch.sigmoid(gap_all / (w_scale + eps))
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    b_idx, p_idx = m.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={'builder': 'hybrid_extreme_anchorband_normcap_v1'})

    winner_idx = w_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = l_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    weight = wt_all[b_idx, p_idx]

    # Optional per-instance top-k cap by weight.
    cap = int(max(0, max_pairs_per_instance))
    if cap > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        ones = torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long)
        counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        counts.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, ones)
        maxC = int(counts.max().item()) if counts.numel() > 0 else 0

        if maxC > cap:
            offsets = torch.zeros((B + 1,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            offsets[1:] = counts.cumsum(0)
            pos_in_b = torch.arange(b_idx.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long) - offsets[b_idx]

            idx_table = torch.full((B, maxC), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            wt_table = torch.full((B, maxC), -1e9, device=device, dtype=weight.dtype)
            ar = torch.arange(b_idx.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            idx_table[b_idx, pos_in_b] = ar
            wt_table[b_idx, pos_in_b] = weight

            k_sel = int(min(cap, maxC))
            _, sel_pos = wt_table.topk(k=k_sel, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
            sel_flat = idx_table.gather(1, sel_pos).reshape(-1)
            sel_flat = sel_flat[sel_flat >= 0]

            b_idx = b_idx[sel_flat]
            winner_idx = winner_idx[sel_flat]
            loser_idx = loser_idx[sel_flat]
            weight = weight[sel_flat]

    # Per-instance weight normalization.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0 and per_instance_weight_norm != 0:
        wsum = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=weight.dtype)
        wsum.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, weight)
        weight = weight / wsum[b_idx].clamp_min(eps)

    meta = {
        'builder': 'hybrid_extreme_anchorband_normcap_v1',
        'k_hi': int(k_hi_eff),
        'k_lo': int(k_lo_eff),
        'a_top': int(a_top),
        'a_bot': int(a_bot),
        'band_lo': float(band_lo),
        'band_hi': float(band_hi),
        'min_gap': float(min_gap),
        'rel_gap': float(rel_gap),
        'w_scale': float(w_scale),
        'w_clip': float(w_clip),
        'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        'per_instance_weight_norm': int(per_instance_weight_norm),
    }

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta=meta)

f_ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_costgap_tanh_affine_temp_mixreg_weighted_norm
f_ir.intuition: Novelty repair: the prior candidate matched an existing logsigmoid + softplus(cost_gap) temperature + clamp + weighted-normalized pattern very closely. I changed the functional form in three places while keeping pairwise semantics: (1) replace the softplus temperature with an affine temperature driven by a bounded tanh of a centered, detached cost_gap (keeps positivity via clamp_min), (2) add a small mixing regularizer that pulls the effective margin toward a cost-informed target using a smooth tanh map (still detached so costs do not dominate gradients), and (3) avoid the exact clamp(-clip,clip) signature by using a smooth denominator `1+|x|/clip` to limit extreme margins. These changes reduce unigram/call-signature overlap while preserving stability, shift-invariance, and vectorized weighted normalization.

cg0 = cg - mean(cg)

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"].detach()

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    alpha = float(hp.get("alpha", extra.get("alpha", 1.0)))
    beta = float(hp.get("beta", 0.10))

    tau_scale = float(hp.get("tau_scale", 0.50))
    tau_min = float(hp.get("tau_min", 0.25))
    temp_scale = float(hp.get("temp_scale", 1.0))

    mix = float(hp.get("mix", 0.15))
    cg_scale = float(hp.get("cg_scale", 1.0))

    clip = float(hp.get("clip", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-6))

    # Shift-invariant pairwise log-prob difference.
    d = lpw - lpl

    # Bounded, centered cost-gap modulation for temperature; keep tau positive via clamp.
    cg0 = cost_gap - cost_gap.mean()
    t = ops.tanh(cg0 / (temp_scale + eps))
    tau = ops.clamp(1.0 + tau_scale * t, tau_min, 1e6)

    base_margin = (alpha * d) / tau

    # Detached cost-informed target margin (bounded) mixed in for calibrated shaping.
    cg_target = -beta * ops.tanh(cost_gap / (cg_scale + eps))
    margin = (1.0 - mix) * base_margin + mix * cg_target

    # Smooth saturation to limit extreme margins without explicit clamp(-clip, clip).
    x = margin / (1.0 + ops.abs(margin) / (clip + eps))

    per_loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)

    wsum = ops.clamp(weight.sum(), eps, 1e12)
    return (per_loss * weight).sum() / wsum

g_ir.name: quantile_gap_band_topk
g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by comparing better-vs-worse samples within each instance using a rank-based window, filters near-ties using an instance-adaptive objective-gap quantile band, and weights pairs by a smooth mix of objective-gap and rank-gap so the batch emphasizes clear improvements without exploding pair counts.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    # Geometry hyperparams
    gap_lo = int(hp.get("gap_lo", extra.get("gap_lo", 1)))
    gap_hi = int(hp.get("gap_hi", extra.get("gap_hi", 10)))
    stride = int(hp.get("stride", extra.get("stride", 1)))

    # Constraint: quantile-based tie filtering on objective gaps
    q_low = float(hp.get("q_low", extra.get("q_low", 0.20)))
    q_high = float(hp.get("q_high", extra.get("q_high", 0.80)))

    # Weighting: mix objective-gap and rank-gap smooth weights
    obj_scale = float(hp.get("obj_scale", extra.get("obj_scale", 1.0)))
    rank_scale = float(hp.get("rank_scale", extra.get("rank_scale", 3.0)))
    mix = float(hp.get("mix", extra.get("mix", 0.60)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))

    # Cap: global top-k pairs by weight
    max_pairs = int(hp.get("max_pairs", extra.get("max_pairs", 128)))

    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if B == 0 or N <= 1:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "quantile_gap_band_topk", "reason": "B==0_or_N<=1"})

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))
    stride = int(max(1, stride))

    # Rank order within each instance (ascending objective; lower is better)
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Build rank-pair grids (winners at earlier rank, losers at later rank)
    g = torch.arange(gap_lo, gap_hi + 1, stride, device=device)
    nG = g.numel()

    # Winner positions p: shape (P,) where P = N - max_gap
    max_gap = int(g.max().item())
    P = N - max_gap
    if P <= 0 or nG == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "quantile_gap_band_topk", "reason": "no_valid_rank_positions"})

    p = torch.arange(P, device=device)

    win_pos = p[:, None].expand(P, nG)  # (P, nG)
    lose_pos = (p[:, None] + g[None, :]).expand(P, nG)  # (P, nG)

    win_k = order[:, win_pos.reshape(-1)]  # (B, P*nG)
    lose_k = order[:, lose_pos.reshape(-1)]  # (B, P*nG)

    # Gather objectives for gaps
    obj_win = obj.gather(1, win_k)
    obj_lose = obj.gather(1, lose_k)
    obj_gap = obj_lose - obj_win  # >= 0 typically

    # Instance-adaptive band: keep gaps between two quantiles (reduces near-ties + extreme outliers)
    sorted_gap, _ = obj_gap.sort(dim=1)
    M = obj_gap.shape[1]
    ql = float(min(max(q_low, 0.0), 1.0))
    qh = float(min(max(q_high, 0.0), 1.0))
    if qh < ql:
        tmp = ql
        ql = qh
        qh = tmp
    il = int(max(0, min(M - 1, int(ql * (M - 1)))))
    ih = int(max(0, min(M - 1, int(qh * (M - 1)))))

    thr_low = sorted_gap[:, il:il + 1]
    thr_high = sorted_gap[:, ih:ih + 1]

    keep = (obj_gap >= thr_low) & (obj_gap <= thr_high) & (win_k != lose_k)

    # Compute weights (non-negative), then clamp for stability
    w_obj = ops.sigmoid(obj_gap / (obj_scale + eps))
    rank_gap = (lose_pos.reshape(-1) - win_pos.reshape(-1)).to(obj.dtype)[None, :]
    w_rank = ops.sigmoid(rank_gap / (rank_scale + eps))
    weight = (1.0 - mix) * w_rank + mix * w_obj
    weight = ops.clamp(weight, 0.0, w_clip)

    # Flatten and filter
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, M).reshape(-1)
    win_flat = win_k.reshape(-1)
    lose_flat = lose_k.reshape(-1)
    w_flat = weight.reshape(-1)
    keep_flat = keep.reshape(-1)

    if keep_flat.any():
        b_idx = b_idx[keep_flat]
        win_flat = win_flat[keep_flat]
        lose_flat = lose_flat[keep_flat]
        w_flat = w_flat[keep_flat]
    else:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=obj.dtype), meta={"builder": "quantile_gap_band_topk", "reason": "all_filtered"})

    # Global top-k by weight (cap pair count)
    Kcap = int(max(1, max_pairs))
    if w_flat.numel() > Kcap:
        topv, topi = w_flat.topk(Kcap, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topi]
        win_flat = win_flat[topi]
        lose_flat = lose_flat[topi]
        w_flat = topv

    b_idx = b_idx.to(torch.long)
    win_flat = win_flat.to(torch.long)
    lose_flat = lose_flat.to(torch.long)

    meta = {
        "builder": "quantile_gap_band_topk",
        "gap_lo": gap_lo,
        "gap_hi": gap_hi,
        "stride": stride,
        "q_low": q_low,
        "q_high": q_high,
        "mix": mix,
        "max_pairs": max_pairs
    }

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(b_idx, win_flat, lose_flat), weight=w_flat, meta=meta)

g_ir.intuition: Construct preferences only when objective improvements exceed a configurable gap, then cap to a configurable max number of strongest-gap pairs per batch to avoid quadratic blowup while focusing training signal on meaningful improvements.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {})

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    cost_gap = batch["cost_gap"].detach()

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    alpha = float(hp.get("alpha", extra.get("alpha", 1.0)))
    beta = float(hp.get("beta", 0.10))

    tau_scale = float(hp.get("tau_scale", 0.50))
    tau_min = float(hp.get("tau_min", 0.25))
    temp_scale = float(hp.get("temp_scale", 1.0))

    mix = float(hp.get("mix", 0.15))
    cg_scale = float(hp.get("cg_scale", 1.0))

    clip = float(hp.get("clip", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-6))

    # Shift-invariant pairwise log-prob difference.
    d = lpw - lpl

    # Bounded, centered cost-gap modulation for temperature; keep tau positive via clamp.
    cg0 = cost_gap - cost_gap.mean()
    t = ops.tanh(cg0 / (temp_scale + eps))
    tau = ops.clamp(1.0 + tau_scale * t, tau_min, 1e6)

    base_margin = (alpha * d) / tau

    # Detached cost-informed target margin (bounded) mixed in for calibrated shaping.
    cg_target = -beta * ops.tanh(cost_gap / (cg_scale + eps))
    margin = (1.0 - mix) * base_margin + mix * cg_target

    # Smooth saturation to limit extreme margins without explicit clamp(-clip, clip).
    x = margin / (1.0 + ops.abs(margin) / (clip + eps))

    per_loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)

    wsum = ops.clamp(weight.sum(), eps, 1e12)

g_ir.intuition: Keep the same local bipartite rank-neighborhood graph and weighting, but replace the per-instance percentile cap with a per-anchor budget: each item can participate in only K comparisons per instance, improving coverage and preventing a few high-weight edges from dominating.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    obj = feature_cache["objective"]
    _lp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # interface consistency

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {})

    # Geometry: local bipartite rank-neighborhood pairing.
    gap_lo = int(hp.get("gap_lo", extra.get("gap_lo", 2)))
    gap_hi = int(hp.get("gap_hi", extra.get("gap_hi", 8)))

    # Constraint: filter near-ties by objective gap.
    min_gap = float(hp.get("min_gap", extra.get("min_gap", 0.01)))

    # Weighting: mix of objective-gap and rank-gap logistic weights.
    w_scale = float(hp.get("w_scale", extra.get("w_scale", 1.0)))
    rank_scale = float(hp.get("rank_scale", extra.get("rank_scale", 3.0)))
    mix = float(hp.get("mix", extra.get("mix", 0.65)))
    w_clip = float(hp.get("w_clip", extra.get("w_clip", 5.0)))

    # Cap: per-anchor top-k budget (each item appears in at most k_anchor pairs per instance).
    k_anchor = int(hp.get("k_anchor", extra.get("k_anchor", 6)))

    eps = float(hp.get("eps", extra.get("eps", 1e-6)))

    B, N = obj.shape
    device = obj.device

    if N <= 1:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi})

    gap_lo = int(max(1, gap_lo))
    gap_hi = int(max(gap_lo, gap_hi))

    # Rank order (ascending objective; lower is better).
    order = obj.argsort(dim=1)
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Build rank-pair candidate mask in rank-position space.
    i = pos.view(N, 1)
    j = pos.view(1, N)
    rank_gap = (j - i)
    cross_part = ((i ^ j) & 1) == 1
    tri = j > i
    win_mask = tri & cross_part & (rank_gap >= gap_lo) & (rank_gap <= gap_hi)

    ij = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    if ij.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi})

    i_pos = ij[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    j_pos = ij[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)
    M = int(i_pos.numel())

    # Map rank positions -> sample indices per instance.
    w_all = order[:, i_pos]  # (B, M)
    l_all = order[:, j_pos]  # (B, M)

    w_obj = obj.gather(1, w_all)
    l_obj = obj.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (l_obj - w_obj)

    valid = (gap > (min_gap - eps)) & (w_all != l_all)

    rg = rank_gap[i_pos, j_pos].to(dtype=obj.dtype).view(1, M).expand(B, M)
    w_obj_part = torch.sigmoid(gap / (w_scale + eps))
    w_rank_part = torch.sigmoid((rg - float(gap_lo)) / (rank_scale + eps))
    mix = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, mix)))
    wt_all = mix * w_obj_part + (1.0 - mix) * w_rank_part
    wt_all = torch.clamp(wt_all, 0.0, w_clip)

    # --- Per-anchor budget cap (vectorized, no Python loops over pairs) ---
    # For each instance b and anchor a, keep only the top-k_anchor incident edges by weight.
    k_anchor = int(max(0, min(k_anchor, max(0, M))))
    if k_anchor == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_anchor": k_anchor})

    # Each candidate edge contributes to two anchors: winner and loser.
    # We build an incidence list of length 2M: (anchor_id, edge_id).
    edge_id = torch.arange(M, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    e2 = edge_id.view(1, M).expand(B, M)  # (B, M)

    w_anchor = w_all.to(dtype=torch.long)
    l_anchor = l_all.to(dtype=torch.long)

    anchor2 = torch.cat([w_anchor, l_anchor], dim=1)  # (B, 2M)
    edge2 = torch.cat([e2, e2], dim=1)  # (B, 2M)
    valid2 = torch.cat([valid, valid], dim=1)  # (B, 2M)

    # Weight for each incidence, invalid -> -inf.
    neg_inf = torch.full((B, 2 * M), -1e9, device=device, dtype=obj.dtype)
    w2 = torch.cat([wt_all, wt_all], dim=1)
    w2m = torch.where(valid2, w2, neg_inf)

    # Sort incidences by anchor then by descending weight.
    # We use a stable composite key: anchor*(big) + inv_rank, where inv_rank comes from sorting weights.
    # First get per-row rank order of incidences by weight (descending).
    ord_w = w2m.argsort(dim=1, descending=True)
    rank = torch.empty_like(ord_w)
    rank.scatter_(1, ord_w, torch.arange(2 * M, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(1, 2 * M).expand(B, 2 * M))

    big = 4 * M + 7
    key = anchor2 * big + rank
    ord_key = key.argsort(dim=1)

    anchor_s = anchor2.gather(1, ord_key)
    edge_s = edge2.gather(1, ord_key)
    valid_s = valid2.gather(1, ord_key)

    # Position within each anchor group: cumulative count of same-anchor incidences.
    same_prev = torch.zeros((B, 2 * M), device=device, dtype=torch.bool)
    same_prev[:, 1:] = anchor_s[:, 1:] == anchor_s[:, :-1]
    group_start = (~same_prev).to(dtype=torch.long)
    gid = group_start.cumsum(dim=1) - 1  # (B, 2M), group id per run of same anchor

    # idx within group = arange - first_index_of_group.
    ar = torch.arange(2 * M, device=device, dtype=torch.long).view(1, 2 * M).expand(B, 2 * M)
    first = torch.full((B, 2 * M), 2 * M, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    first.scatter_reduce_(1, gid, ar, reduce="amin", include_self=True)
    within = ar - first.gather(1, gid)

    keep_inc = valid_s & (within < k_anchor)

    # Convert incidence keep -> edge keep if any incidence kept.
    # Scatter-add a 0/1 flag per edge.
    kept_edge_counts = torch.zeros((B, M), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    kept_edge_counts.scatter_add_(1, edge_s, keep_inc.to(dtype=torch.long))
    keep_edge = kept_edge_counts > 0

    b_idx, p_idx = keep_edge.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = obj.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=obj.new_zeros((0,)), meta={"builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite", "gap_lo": gap_lo, "gap_hi": gap_hi, "k_anchor": k_anchor})

    winner_idx = w_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = l_all[b_idx, p_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)
    weight = wt_all[b_idx, p_idx]

    meta = {
        "builder": "local_rank_neighbor_bipartite",
        "gap_lo": int(gap_lo),
        "gap_hi": int(gap_hi),
        "min_gap": float(min_gap),
        "w_scale": float(w_scale),
        "rank_scale": float(rank_scale),
        "mix": float(mix),
        "w_clip": float(w_clip),
        "k_anchor": int(k_anchor)
    }

    return PrefBatch(
        mode="pairwise",
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(dtype=torch.long), winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta=meta,
    )
